entries.heading: Section 415 of division E of Public Law 112-74 is amended
ancestors: DIVISION G—DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, ENVIRONMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 411.  Section 415 of division E of Public Law 112-74 is amended 
by striking ``and 2013'' and inserting ``through 2015''.

entries.heading: None of the funds made available in this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION J—MILITARY CONSTRUCTION AND VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 411.  None of the funds made available in this Act may be used 
by an agency of the executive branch to pay for first-class travel by an 
employee of the agency in contravention of sections 301-10.122 through 
301-10.124 of title 41, Code of Federal Regulations.
